stories.title: FAA ground stop disrupting travel for multiple college football teams, officials
stories.summary: Travel plans for multiple college football teams have been disrupted by the FAA's nationwide ground stop of all flights because of communications problems.

stories.title: First Cousins: QB to get start vs. Packers in Vikings return
stories.summary: Coach Kevin O'Connell called Kirk Cousins' ability to get reacquainted with the Vikings' offense "impressive."

stories.title: Sources: Tide to start QB Mack vs. Vandy; injured Russell available, if needed
stories.summary: Alabama is expected to start QB Austin Mack vs. Vanderbilt, sources told ESPN, with starter Keelon Russell (ankle) expected to be available, if needed.

stories.title: Murray wants trade from Pelicans; both sides working on resolution
stories.summary: Pelicans guard Dejounte Murray wants a trade from the franchise, and his agent, Klutch Sports CEO Rich Paul, and team officials have started working on a resolution.

stories.title: Sources: Bauers parlays career season into 4-year, $58M contract with Red Sox
stories.summary: First baseman Jake Bauers, who is coming off a career season with the Brewers, has agreed to a four-year, $58M contract with the Red Sox, sources told ESPN.
